Official Voice of the Regional Directorate
SECTOR 7 POWER PLANT REPORT: MINOR INCIDENT CONTAINED
A minor fault at Sector 7 caused a brief pressure release. Radiation claims are unverified rumors, and spreading panic is illegal. The light haze is harmless; operations continue as normal.
ALL RESIDENTS MUST COMPLY WITH CHECKPOINT INSPECTION.
Official Voice of the Regional Directorate
"MUTATION" CLAIMS DISPROVED: LOCAL CITIZENS REPORT NORMAL HEALTH
Deformity rumors are false propaganda. "I feel fine, even better than before," says resident Otar. Minor facial changes are within approved limits. Spreading panic is illegal.
AVOIDING CHECKPOINT INSPECTION IS PUNISHABLE BY LAW.
Official Voice of the Regional Directorate
MONSTER SIGHTINGS ARE JUST HYSTERIA: TAKE OUR FUN CITIZEN QUIZ!
Claims of "creatures" roaming Saplavi are absurd. Try our quiz: Can You Spot the Real Human? All faces above meet state guidelines. Stop letting imagination ruin your workday.
AVOIDING CHECKPOINT INSPECTION IS AN ACT OF TREASON; EVADERS WILL BE SHOT ON SIGHT.

ROUTINE HEALTH CHECKS UNDERWAY: JOIN US FOR THE MUNICIPAL FESTIVAL!
Door-to-door inspections are clearing up isolated health incidents. Tonight, famous clown Ocho hosts the town festival. "You mourned, cried, and died, now it is time to laugh!"
